## What is publicly indexable

Per-term HTML pages at /atlas/{slug}/ contain inline JSON-LD (Schema.org DefinedTerm + skos:Concept + prov:Entity). All terms discoverable via sitemap.xml. Lightweight metadata descriptors at /exports/.

## What is NOT publicly distributed at this stage

Bulk machine-readable exports (RDF/Turtle bulk, JSON-LD bulk, OWL ontology bulk, CSV, JSONL, embeddings, full relations graph, QA-pairs, prompt library, ROS2 messages, methodology details).

These are stored in a restricted Zenodo deposit (Concept-DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20118267, files locked, metadata public).

## Researcher access

Researchers seeking access to bulk deep-layer for legitimate scholarly purposes contact via ORCID-linked channels: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-3773-7796 or augmanitai@gmail.com. Subject to brief research-purpose statement and attribution agreement.
